name: cutting
what: A knife's plane cut through a soft juicy tissue (the lychee's aril): the cut cells' relief, levelled by the juice that runs out of them, and beads of juice on the face. A height map (mm) on the cut face, for a bump ('texture displacement'). Tags as materials/lychee/material.json. The cut's plane itself is the object's (objects/lychee/lychee.py: every part is closed by its face in the plane).

cell_diameter_mm.source: the aril's parenchyma cells, not measured for lychee (S4 search found no micrograph with a scale); the range is that of fleshy-fruit parenchyma [A]. Checked on the section's render against the face's glints

cell_depth_mm.source: a cut cell's opened lumen, as a shallow bowl between standing walls

size_mm.source: the aril's flesh in groups of juice cells between thin membranes (its fibres); a cut fruit shows lobes a few mm across (ref/lychee/commons2). Not measured; S4 v6: 3.0 first; about a third of the frame across, about 4.5 mm at the section's framing

bulge_mm.source: turgid tissue swells into the free face after the cut, each group as a low dome, the membranes between them as creases: h = b (1 - (1 - e/e_max)^k), e the distance to the group's border. Not measured; S4: 0.1 first, the domes did not show under the slump's glints; v6: 0.2, with the larger sacs the same slopes need more

profile_power.source: k in the dome's profile: 2 a rounded dome (its slope falls linearly to the top), 3 flatter-topped; S4 v6: 3 first, its flat tops mirrored the light as blots

juice_level_sigma_mm.source: the juice film levels the relief finer than its thickness (surface tension): a Gaussian of this width; S4: 0.03 first: the cut cells' bowls caught the light everywhere as a glitter, where a fresh cut's juice film is smooth and glossy

wavelength_mm.source: the soft flesh does not stay a plane after the knife: groups of juice cells bulge or sink as they relax and drain; a Gaussian-filtered noise of about this wavelength (sigma = wavelength / 4)

rms_mm.source: slopes of about 10 degrees, so the face's glints scatter over a softbox's width (S4: with only the 12 um cell bowls the face was a mirror of the dark studio). Not measured; S4: 0.02 first: its glints made random squiggles over the face, hiding the sacs

per_mm2.source: beads of juice on a fresh cut. S4: 0.04 first: about two in the section's macro frame; real cut or torn lychee flesh glistens with many small ones (ref/lychee/commons2: Filo gen', Lychee_600)

contact_angle_deg.source: juice on wet tissue; a spherical cap of height r tan(angle/2)

edge_taper_mm.source: the relief fades to 0 at the aril's edges (the gaps to pericarp and seed)

minutes_after_cut.source: the after-cut processes (juice spreading and draining, the cotyledon browning) at t = 0: not modelled beyond the state at the cut

texture_px.source: the square texture over the fruit's section, about 0.01 mm a pixel: 20 pixels a cell; S4: 2048 first, about 3 screen pixels a texel at the section's 2.55x
